title: C^1 graph pieces of spt V: area comparison, tangent planes and Lebesgue points
statement: For n >= 1 and p > n there is delta_E > 0 such that: if U is open, V a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U with generalized mean curvature H satisfying AllardHypotheses H p delta rho with 0 < delta <= delta_E, q a linear isometry, Omega open in R^n, u : R^n -> R^l of class C^1 on Omega, and the graph piece F(Omega), F(x) := q(graphPoint(x, u x)), is contained in spt V cap B^o_rho(0), then (E1) for every Borel A contained in Omega and Borel g >= 0, the integral over A of g(F x) dx is at most the integral over F(A) of g d mu; (E2) for a.e. x in Omega, V.tangentProj(F x) is the orthogonal projection onto q(span{graphPoint(v, Du(x) v)}); (E3) for a.e. x in Omega, mu(B_s(F x))^-1 times the integral over B_s(F x) of |p_y - p_{F x}|^2 d mu(y) tends to 0 as s -> 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ δE : ℝ, 0 < δE ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δE → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → q '' graphOver u Ω ⊆ V.support ∩ ball 0 ρ → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in A, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u A, g y ∂V.weight) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))) = (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)))).starProjection) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (V.weight (closedBall (q (graphPoint x (u x))) s))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in closedBall (q (graphPoint x (u x))) s, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (V.tangentProj y - V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))))) ∂V.weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
